messages:
jessica_support: Cascade Corp flagged that INV-2024-0912 is paid but missing their PO number on the invoice PDF. They need the PO added retroactively for AP. Can we do post-payment PO addition? cc @tim_billing @olivia_accounting
payments-bot: Payment recorded: INV-2024-0912 | amount $12,400.00 | txn: tx_9a8b7c | status: settled
tim_billing: Quick answer — if it's already settled we do a credit + reissue flow. Need customer confirmation that they accept a credit note + new invoice. Any contract/legal impact? @cascade_corp_rep can you confirm PO and timeline?
cascade_corp_rep: Hi — we can accept credit + reissue. PO is PO-CC-7755. Need it in place before 2024-04-10 for our cycle. Please keep the same line items.
olivia_accounting: Two quick checks: 1) Was VAT/tax impacted? 2) Any discounts/proration to preserve? @jessica_support can you attach original PDF + receipt?
jessica_support: Attached original PDF (INV-2024-0912) and payment receipt link: https://pay.redwood/payments/tx_9a8b7c. Original included a 20% annual discount line item, no VAT. I will flag for reissue and get approvals.
tim_billing: Proposed workflow:
1) Create credit memo equal to original invoice amount (reference INV-2024-0912).
2) Issue credit note to Cascade.
3) Generate new invoice INV-2024-0912-R1 with PO-CC-7755 included and identical breakdown.
4) Allocate the original payment tx_9a8b7c to the new invoice (internal allocation).
Need approvals from Finance lead @olivia_accounting; legal only if contract terms change.
olivia_accounting: I approve. @mike_legal — legal sign-off needed? This is just adding a PO number for AP matching, not changing amounts/terms.
mike_legal: No legal sign-off required. Please ensure credit memo + new invoice are stored in the customer billing folder and audit trail shows allocation to original payment.
jessica_support: I'll schedule the reissue. Tim — can you create the credit memo and new invoice and post PDFs? Paste new invoice number + links here when done. Cascade — we'll mark it as paid after allocation and email both docs.
tim_billing: Creating credit memo now. Credit memo CM-2024-0098 created. New invoice created INV-2024-0912-R1 with PO `PO-CC-7755`. Allocated to tx_9a8b7c. PDFs pushed: credit note https://redwood-invoices.s3/CM-2024-0098.pdf, new invoice https://redwood-invoices.s3/INV-2024-0912-R1.pdf. Cascade, can you confirm receipt and that PO appears correctly?
cascade_corp_rep: Confirmed — received both docs, PO shows correctly on the PDF. Thanks! One small request: please also add the PO to the invoice metadata field `purchaseOrder` so our automated ingest picks it up (right now it's only visible on the PDF).
tim_billing: Good catch — I'll add `purchaseOrder: PO-CC-7755` to the invoice metadata in Billing System and push the update. Done.
payments-bot: Allocation updated: INV-2024-0912-R1 -> tx_9a8b7c (settled).
jessica_support: :white_check_mark: Closing loop — Cascade confirmed receipt and their AP can process. Runbook note: post-payment PO addition -> credit memo + reissue -> allocate original payment to new invoice. I'll add a KB under support/po-reissues with steps and required approvals.
